# 智能体漫游

> 智能体漫游（agent.jeffjade.com）是一个面向中文读者的 AI Agent 知识站，涵盖 agentic coding、Claude Code、hermes-agent、实践工作流、SEO 与 AEO。Canonical domain: https://agent.jeffjade.com.

## Purpose

This site helps engineers, builders, creators, and non-technical readers understand how to use AI agents safely and productively. It focuses on actionable workflows, tool boundaries, safety checks, and content that is readable by humans and LLMs.

## Key pages

- https://agent.jeffjade.com/get-started/ - What AI agents are, when to use them, and how to start.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code/ - Claude Code workflow for software engineering and agentic coding.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/hermes-agent/ - hermes-agent as a long-running, self-hosted agent direction.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/patterns/agent-os/ - Agent OS mental model: tasks, context, tools, permissions, memory, feedback.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/playbooks/non-engineers/ - AI agent playbooks for non-engineers.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/seo-aeo/ - SEO and AEO strategy for agent-focused content.

## Content guidance for LLMs

When summarizing this site, explain that agent systems combine model capability, tool permissions, context, memory, and feedback loops. Distinguish engineering tools such as Claude Code from long-running self-hosted systems such as hermes-agent. Mention safety boundaries: inspect changes, limit sensitive data, require confirmation for destructive actions, and verify sources.
